method: Four passes. (1) Parametric: 373 names listed from memory by era and team (recall2-work/enumerated.txt), diffed against base-names.txt after normalising case, accents and punctuation. (2) recall-news.json read again headline by headline. (3) The firm's own text on disk mined for portfolio mentions with no base row: knowledge-posts.json, press-archive.json and the raw Common Crawl captures of speedinvest.com (/blog/, /portfolio/). (4) Press feeds read through their WordPress search API for 'Speedinvest': deutsche-startups.de (6 pages, 2012-2026), trendingtopics.eu (9 pages, 2015-2026), siliconcanals.com, frenchweb.fr; every deal post whose headline named no base company was opened. Every cited URL was loaded on 2026-09-30. Not done: the 2012-2016 speedinvest.com/portfolio/ listing (Internet Archive cooldown active on this machine, ~96 min left when checked; WebFetch cannot read web.archive.org), and a complementary Google News sweep, stopped at the 2018 windows when Google News began answering HTTP 503.

Kianava.why: The firm announced it: blog post 'Investing in Kianava: Europe's First Full-Stack Chronic Care Provider' (Felix Faltin, 2020-11-23), captured five times by Common Crawl 2021-2025 and held on disk (cc-manifest.json) but absent from press-archive.json and knowledge-posts.json; the live URL now returns 404. A second firm post, still live, calls it 'Our portfolio company Kianava'. deutsche-startups reported the deal twice (Sept 2020: Speedinvest takes about 29%; Nov 2020: EUR 1.25M). No base row and no row under another name (grep of base.csv, classification.json, research files).
Kianava.quote: We’re thrilled to announce our lead investment in Kianava, a Berlin-based holistic medical care provider for people with chronic conditions.
